blocks.size_first: SIZE FIRST: the mini bag charm is TINY, the maker's measurements: 9.5 cm (3.7 in) tall to the top of its handles and 5.5 cm (2.2 in) wide. Its body is only about as wide as three adult fingers side by side and about as tall as one finger is long; with its handles it is about half as tall as an adult hand is long. It is smaller than a coffee mug and many times smaller than any handbag. One wireless earbuds case alone fills its opening. The gold key ring is about the size of a fingertip. It is empty: nothing sticks out of its open top except a little white tissue paper, as in image 1.
blocks.product_block: The bag charm is the REAL product in the reference images and it must not change: a mini bucket-shaped bag in deep burgundy (wine red) pebbled grain faux leather, matte, wider at the top than the base, open top with no zip and no flap; two rolled round burgundy handles with darker brown-burgundy painted edges rising in two arches; one vertical burgundy strap down the front that passes through a small rectangular gold buckle loop at the top rim; a polished gold padlock hanging from a small gold ring and round gold grommet on that strap, with a U-shaped shackle and three engraved horizontal lines on its body, no letters and no logo; four small round gold feet under the base; a small polished gold split key ring on a short gold chain, attached at the base of the left-hand handle; the chain ends in that plain ring only, with no key, no charm and no tag on it; a thin silk twilly scarf in pink, light blue and white with thin black line art knotted around the base of the right-hand handle, its long tail hanging down past the base with frayed ends. No text, no logo, no monogram anywhere on the bag; all hardware is gold, never silver. It is always this open-top bucket shape: never a flap bag, no front flap, no turn lock. The twilly scarf belongs to the bag charm only: no scarf on any other bag. The scarf is tied in ONE small knot around the base of the RIGHT-hand handle only, exactly as in the real photos; it is never draped over both handles, never tied as a bow over the top and never wide, and its single long tail hangs straight down past the base on the right.
blocks.hand_block: ONLY one hand enters from the frame edge: Grace's hand exactly as in the hand reference sheet: medium-brown skin, slim fingers, natural pink nails with crisp white French tips; on the wrist a FLAT gold bracelet of rectangular links like a watch band (NO watch face) and a thin gold chain with small pearls and a gold leaf charm; rings exactly as in the sheet: a silver crown-shaped stack ring, a silver ring with a small heart-shaped stone and a blue silicone band that is a RING worn on the ring finger, never on the wrist. Whole wrist visible, a little forearm in a soft cream knit sleeve may show, five fingers, natural knuckles and skin texture. The fingers GRIP what they touch, thumb on one side and fingers on the other.
blocks.no_hand: No hand, arm, fingers or people anywhere in the frame.
blocks.handbag_block: The handbag is a plain chocolate-brown smooth leather top-handle bag, slouchy and soft, with no logo, no hardware text and no charms other than the burgundy mini bag charm.
blocks.light: Bright soft daylight, clean neutral white balance, never yellow, golden, dark or moody.
blocks.suffix: Vertical 9:16 photo, a single frame from a phone video, realistic leather grain and fabric texture, sharp focus on the bag charm. Every other item is plain and unbranded. No text, no captions, no watermark, no phone UI.
blocks.omni_head: Recreate image 1 exactly as the first frame: keep its room, light, framing{hand} and the bag charm exactly. The bag charm is the real product in images 2 to {sheet}: deep burgundy pebbled faux leather, two rolled burgundy handles, gold rectangular buckle loop and gold padlock with three engraved lines and no letters, four gold feet, the small gold key ring on a short gold chain at the left-hand handle, the pink, light blue and white twilly scarf knotted on the right-hand handle; it matches the close-ups colour for colour and never changes shape, size or colour; no text, letters or logos appear on it.
blocks.omni_tail: Vertical 9:16 phone footage, bright neutral daylight that never changes, realistic leather and fabric, the padlock and scarf never warp, shimmer or change. No music, no voice, no captions, no on-screen text.

shots.words: For the person who loves anything mini…
shots.still: Eye-level side-on view in front of the wooden table in the room photo, the pink candle soft and out of focus behind. ONE hand and forearm enter from the top right edge and fill the top half of the frame; the thumb and index finger pinch the charm's two handles together, and the mini bag charm hangs in the air just below the fingertips, its front with the gold padlock facing the lens. Nothing is under the charm: it hangs freely, well above the table. The charm is tiny next to the hand: its body is only as wide as one wireless earbuds case, the back of the hand is clearly WIDER than the whole charm, and the charm with its handles is no taller than the hand's two middle fingers are long. Exactly ONE hand in the whole frame: no second hand, no palm, fingers or arm under or behind the charm.
shots.motion: The hand gives the charm one small, slow lift and lowers it again while the camera pushes in a little; the charm keeps facing the lens, stays small next to the hand, and never turns or swings.

shots.words: How cute is this little purse?!
shots.props: a plain white ceramic coffee mug
shots.still: Low eye-level view across the wooden table top in the room photo. The mini bag charm stands on the table, front with the gold padlock facing the lens, slightly left of centre; a plain white ceramic coffee mug about 10 cm tall stands a hand's width behind it to the right. The charm's body is clearly shorter and narrower than the mug: only the top of its handles comes near the mug's rim, and the mug is about one and a half times as wide. The pink candle is soft in the background.
shots.motion: Camera: a slow, low push-in toward the charm; nothing on the table moves.

shots.words: You know how your earbuds always end up at the bottom of your bag?
shots.still: Looking down into a big open chocolate-brown smooth leather tote bag resting on the cream sofa from the room photo. The hand has entered from the top right edge and reaches deep into the bag, fingers searching among a jumble at the bottom: a plain white wireless earbuds case half hidden under folded receipts, a set of keys and a plain black wallet. The bag interior is a plain tan lining. No bag charm in this shot.
shots.motion: The hand digs through the jumble at the bottom of the bag, pushing the receipts aside, as if searching; the bag stays still. Camera: small handheld drift.

shots.words: It clips right onto your handbag,
shots.still: Close view of the top handle of the chocolate-brown handbag on the cream sofa from the room photo, the window soft behind. The hand has entered from the right edge and pinches the charm's small gold key ring between thumb and index finger, the ring already looped around the handbag's handle; the charm hangs below on its short gold chain with its front and gold padlock facing the lens. The charm is tiny next to the hand: its body is only as wide as one wireless earbuds case, the back of the hand is clearly WIDER than the whole charm, and the charm with its handles is no taller than the hand's two middle fingers are long.
shots.motion: The fingers close the gold key ring around the handbag's handle and then let go; the charm hangs still from the ring, front facing the lens.

shots.words: and you can stash your earbuds,
shots.props: one plain white wireless earbuds case
shots.still: Close view from slightly above of the mini bag charm standing on the wooden table from the room photo. ONE plain white wireless earbuds case already sits upright in the charm's open top and fills the opening wall to wall, its upper half still sticking out; the hand has entered from the top right edge and one fingertip rests on the top of the case, about to press it down. The earbuds case and the charm's body are the SAME width, so the charm is clearly tiny next to the fingertip and the case. Nothing else is inside the charm.
shots.motion: The fingertip presses the earbuds case down into the charm until only its top shows, then the hand lifts away and leaves the frame at the top right; nothing else goes in, and the charm stays standing and does not move.

shots.words: lip balm, keys, or other tiny essentials inside.

shots.still: Close three-quarter view from slightly above of the empty mini bag charm standing open on the wooden table from the room photo, framed a little closer. The hand has entered from the right edge holding ONE slim clear lip gloss tube with pink gloss just above the open top; nothing is inside the charm yet. The charm is tiny next to the hand: its body is no wider than three of the fingers.
shots.motion: The hand slips the lip gloss tube down into the charm until only its white cap peeks out, lets go and leaves the frame at the right; nothing else goes in, and the charm stays standing and does not move.

shots.still: Macro close-up of the front of the mini bag charm standing on the wooden table: the gold padlock with its three engraved lines, the gold grommet and ring, the rectangular gold buckle loop at the rim and the knotted pink, light blue and white twilly scarf on the right-hand handle all in sharp focus, the pebbled burgundy grain clearly visible. The room is a soft blur behind.
shots.motion: Camera: a very slow push-in and slight rise from the padlock up to the scarf knot; the charm does not move.

shots.words: make it look so much more expensive than a typical bag charm.
shots.still: Three-quarter view of the chocolate-brown handbag sitting upright on the cream sofa from the room photo, the bright window behind. The mini bag charm hangs on its short gold chain and gold key ring from the base of the handbag's left handle, front with the gold padlock facing the lens, its scarf tail hanging down beside it. Next to the handbag the charm is TINY: the handbag is about six times wider and three times taller than the charm, and the whole charm, handles included, is smaller than the handbag's handle loop. The padlock face is plain polished gold with only its three engraved lines: no mark, symbol or letter.
shots.motion: Camera: a very slow, slight push-in toward the handbag, only a little closer by the end; the charm hangs still and keeps facing the lens. The camera stays far: the move is very slight, the handbag stays fully in frame and the charm stays small in the frame, about one sixth of the frame width, for the whole clip; no close-up.

shots.words: AND it makes the cutest little stocking stuffer!
shots.props: a plain cream cable-knit Christmas stocking
shots.still: Close view of a plain cream cable-knit Christmas stocking with no text, hanging in front of the fireplace from the room photo, the green tree soft at the left. The hand has entered from the right edge and holds the mini bag charm by its two handles just above the open top of the stocking, front and gold padlock facing the lens. The charm is small next to the stocking: it is much narrower than the stocking's cuff. The charm is tiny next to the hand: its body is no wider than three of the fingers. The stocking is a regular adult Christmas stocking and far bigger than the charm: its cuff opening is about four times as wide as the charm, so the charm drops inside it the way a small tube of eye cream would.
shots.motion: Camera: a very slow, slight push-in toward the stocking, only a little closer by the end; the charm sits still inside the stocking cuff with its lower half hidden inside, and the stocking hangs still. The camera stays far: the whole stocking cuff stays in frame and the charm stays small, about one sixth of the frame width, for the whole clip; no close-up.
